patch_list: Redirects Google Sign-In to MicroG RE (app.revanced.android.gms): forces normal sign-in mode, rewrites the sign-in action/package, and drops the unused ID-token request. Pair with the 'MicroG signature spoof' manifest patch or login fails…

Adds the original Play signature (SHA-1) as the app.revanced.android.gms.SPOOFED_PACKAGE_SIGNATURE manifest meta-data, so MicroG RE sends the original signature to Google during sign-in and the re-signed app is accepted. Required for the '…

Makes Shohay appear installed from Google Play (com.android.vending) so a manually installed build does not hit 'not installed from Play Store' paths. Same logic as the Morphe universal 'Change installer source' patch. Verified on Shohay 2…

Unlocks all weekly premium videos by making SubscribedWeeksDeriver return every week (1-42) as subscribed with 1000 days remaining. The premium gate is evaluated locally from this result, so no server change is needed. Verified on Shohay 2…
